title: Define derived metadata schema and extensibility contract
description: Specify the metadata struct embedded in the root node: message_id (String), newsgroups (Vec<String>), hlc_timestamp (HLC bytes), operator_signature (bytes, signs root node CID), byte_count (u64), line_count (u64), content_type_summary (String). Define the extensibility contract: schema_version increments on breaking changes; unknown fields are preserved round-trip.
notes: Size: S. Depends on Issue A (Define article root node DAG-CBOR schema).
